scope: Actual GPU geometry and resource lifecycle readback, not end-to-end qualification of every 3D file format

Float64 normalization preserves small geometry at translation 1e12 and extreme finite scales
Model vertex and depth allocation refusal preserves existing resources
Raster and model textures compete for shared parent budget

remaining: All supported model parsers through RAM/swap/display pipeline
